proposals.title: Exposure concentration: by_signal_type (directional-long monoculture) × by_regime = UP_TRI+BULL_PROXY in Bull regime (100.0%)

claim.what: Concentration risk: by_signal_type (directional-long monoculture) × by_regime = UP_TRI+BULL_PROXY in Bull regime; recommended action: Pause new entries in signal_type=UP_TRI and signal_type=BULL_PROXY until either (a) the Bull×UP_TRI cohort promotes above Candidate tier, or (b) at least 2 non-directional-long positions (e.g., DOWN_TRI or hedge) are added to reduce directional-long share below 85%.
claim.expected_effect: Trader awareness of tail risk: If Bull regime flips to Choppy or Bear, all 16 positions face simultaneous adverse pressure with no offsetting exposure and no validated cohort edge to justify holding through the transition — full-book drawdown with no diversification cushion.

evidence: Two concentrated cells at 12.5% each: UP_TRI×Bull×Chem and UP_TRI×Bull×Bank
Both concentrated cells match only Candidate-tier Bull×UP_TRI cohort (n=145) — unvalidated edge
Extends multi-week consecutive warn streak of directional-long monoculture on unvalidated cohort
risks: Recommendation may be over-cautious; concentration may be edge-validated
Trader may already be aware; informational only

proposals.reversibility: Informational warning; no system mutation. Suppresses on next run if concentration drops below threshold.

decision_metadata.recommended_action: Pause new entries in signal_type=UP_TRI and signal_type=BULL_PROXY until either (a) the Bull×UP_TRI cohort promotes above Candidate tier, or (b) at least 2 non-directional-long positions (e.g., DOWN_TRI or hedge) are added to reduce directional-long share below 85%.
decision_metadata.tail_risk_scenario: If Bull regime flips to Choppy or Bear, all 16 positions face simultaneous adverse pressure with no offsetting exposure and no validated cohort edge to justify holding through the transition — full-book drawdown with no diversification cushion.
decision_metadata.llm_rationale: Regime concentration at 75% Bull sits just below the 0.80 threshold and no single cell exceeds 0.20 (top cells at 12.5%), but the book is 100% directional-long (UP_TRI 10/16 = 62.5% + BULL_PROXY 6/16 = 37.5%) on a Bull×UP_TRI cohort that remains Candidate-tier (n=145) — unvalidated edge. Both concentrated cells (UP_TRI×Bull×Chem, UP_TRI×Bull×Bank) match only the Candidate cohort, extending a multi-week warn streak of directional-long exposure without cohort validation.
